text:
olivia-customer: Hey team, streaming started failing for us after token rotation yesterday. The client (py sdk 2.4.1) gets an empty chunk then the async iterator hangs and never yields final event. We noticed billing shows two partial responses for some requests. Anyone seen this?

emma-support: Hi @olivia-customer sorry about that — can you paste a minimal repro? Is this only Python or also TS/Go?

olivia-customer: Repro steps: 1) open SSE stream, 2) wait ~55s for token auto-refresh, 3) server sends 204 then new handshake, client shows an empty '\n' chunk and iterator.loop stops. Happens 100% for long-lived sessions. We saw same with TS client but less frequently.

emma-support: Thanks. Can you send headers from the failed request and the SDK version? Also does toggling HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL help?

olivia-customer: Headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, Accept: text/event-stream, x-client-version: py-2.4.1. HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL didn't change behaviour.

raj-engineer: tagging because this sounds like session rotation race. @nina-oncall please triage. Quick thought: if auth refresh triggers a new session id but the runtime emits a keepalive that is parsed as an empty data frame, some SDKs treat that as EOF.

mike-qa: I reproduced locally with our long-poll test harness. Python iterator yields '' (empty string) then awaits next() forever. I captured the wire: server sends:
```
: keepalive


data: 


```
and then immediately rotates tokens with a 101 header. Parser logs show it treats data: <empty> as an event with no payload which then triggers end-of-stream in async generator.

emma-support: That's useful. Can you attach a short patch to the parser to ignore empty data events as a workaround? Also customers seeing duplicate billing likely from client reconnect + server replay.

raj-engineer: Agreed. I think 2.4.1 changed the SSE tokenizer to emit empty events when only keepalive + immediate handshake happen. I'm going to open an issue referencing SDK ticket #INF-842 and assign. Workaround: downgrade to 2.3.8 or set auth rotation to prewarmed token so the handshake doesn't happen mid-stream.

olivia-customer: Downgrade helped, thanks. Do you want logs/packet capture?

mike-qa: Yes please send a PCAP or curl --include output. Also include the exact request id header we add: x-rw-request-id if present.

nina-oncall: Escalating to eng-runtime. @raj-engineer can you confirm if runtime will avoid handshake mid-stream or if SDK should swallow empty events? We need decision for patch and release cadence — customers are seeing duplicates and billing concerns.

raj-engineer: Runtime-side: we can avoid token-rotate handoff by supporting token pre-attach (short term fix) but requires infra rollout (hours). SDK-side: patch to ignore empty data events is quick and can ship as 2.4.2. I'll open PR for Python/TS/Go parsers to treat data: with only whitespace as no-op.

emma-support: Noted. @olivia-customer please DM the PCAP and sample code. We'll track INF-842 and keep you updated. For billing I'll flag Finance to investigate duplicate partial counts. Sorry again. :pray:

deploy-bot: Release pipeline triggered for hotfix branch sdk-sse-empty-data-fix -> will run unit/integration tests.

olivia-customer: Sent PCAP and sample via DM. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

mike-qa: Tests added to cover keepalive + immediate handshake sequence. Also added a regression test that simulates token rotation at t=55s.

raj-engineer: Created INF-842, linked runtime ticket INF-843 for longer-term token pre-attach. Patch ready in draft PR. ETA for SDK patch: next 24h, runtime mitigation TBD but targeted this week.

nina-oncall: Marking as P1 until SDK hotfix lands.

emma-support: Closing loop here — will post release notes and workaround. If anyone on thread sees further anomalies after 2.4.2, please reopen. :white_check_mark:
